unlisted_practices: Running all inference (classifier and biomedical LLM) locally on the user's own host to avoid transmitting health data to remote servers
Reporting ensemble-vote-derived confidence and ranked differential signals alongside the primary prediction
Displaying an explicit clinical safety disclaimer with each prediction
Fusing wearable vitals (steps, heart rate, sleep) with self-reported symptoms into a longitudinal health score

screen.reason: The paper introduces AlamX, an architecture/system combining local tabular classifiers (Random Forest/XGBoost) and a local LLM (BioMistral) for privacy-preserving symptom triage. It benchmarks system performance and demonstrates the prototype rather than testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
